mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 signals stronger corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1, or during non-expansionary phases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% triggers a monetary tightening cycle, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5%, or during non-tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation (CPIAUCSL rising) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS falling) create a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of simultaneous CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS declines, or when other macro factors dominate.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO) in a late-cycle expansion signal labor market strength and supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods with UNRATE < 4.5% and rising INDPRO, or when other economic factors override these signals.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) and demand (GDPC1) simultaneously signal robust labor demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of simultaneous PAYEMS and GDPC1 increases, or when other factors dominate.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals labor market strength and reduced risk premium, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%, or during contractions in the labor market.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, high FEDFUNDS and low industrial production (GDPC1 contraction) signal reduced liquidity and economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 in the tightening cycle, or when other factors override these signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over time reflects stronger supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of rising INDPRO, or when supply-side factors are absent.
